name: Seline Analytics
mood: Quiet analyst's desk on warm paper, with stone neutrals, whisper-weight Roobert headings, flat white cards, one cyan accent, and a single elevated dashboard preview.

pureWhite.role: Card surfaces, elevated panels, nav, and input fills.

stoneBorder.role: Hairline borders on cards, nav, and inputs.

stoneMuted.role: Secondary borders, subtle tints, and decorative separators.

ashGray.role: Helper text, icon strokes, and disabled states.

warmGray.role: Body text, nav links, and secondary copy.

inkBlack.role: Primary headings, emphasized body, and strong icons.

soot.role: Dark tab pills and sparing inverted surfaces.

skyWash.role: Soft wash behind highlighted text spans.

cyanSignal.role: Primary CTA fill, active links, and brand icon strokes.

cyanEdge.role: Outlined action border, linked labels, and lightweight interactive emphasis.

rules: Use Roobert-style type for headings and display.
Keep Roobert display headings at weight 400.
Use Inter for body, navigation, captions, labels, and dense UI.
Use one cyan highlight span per headline maximum.

md.role: Light lift for flat content cards.

sm.role: Small decorative chip or icon lift.

card.role: Flat cards, nav, and input fills.

floatingPreview.role: Hero dashboard screenshot with deeper shadow.

invertedSection.role: Dark tab pills and sparing inverted panels.

components.name: Primary CTA Button
components.recipe: Cyan Signal pill fill, Cyan Edge border, Pure White text, Inter 500, 8px by 16px padding, 9999px radius.

components.name: Secondary Ghost Button
components.recipe: Transparent pill, Stone Border outline, Ink Black text, 8px by 16px padding.

components.name: Flat Content Card
components.recipe: Pure White fill, 10px radius, 1px Stone Border, 24px padding, optional md shadow.

components.name: Floating Dashboard Preview
components.recipe: Pure White frame, 16px radius, 8px padding, shadow-xl, grayscale product screenshot.

components.name: Highlighted Text Span
components.recipe: Cyan Edge text with Sky Wash pill background, one per headline maximum.

components.name: Tab Pill Group
components.recipe: Active Soot fill with white text; inactive transparent with Stone Border.

do: Use Stone Canvas as page background.
Use Pure White only for elevated surfaces.
Use one cyan highlight span per headline.
Use 1px Stone Border as the main structural device.
Reserve shadow-xl for one dashboard preview.
dont: Do not introduce new accent colors.
Do not use heavy shadows on content cards.
Do not set headings in Inter.
Do not use Pure White as page background.
Do not use dark filled primary buttons.
Do not add gradients or glassmorphism.

imagery.style: Product UI screenshots, muted dashboard preview, and one grayscale line-art mascot sticker.
rules: Use the dashboard as the hero object.
Apply grayscale and slight contrast reduction to product screenshots.
Use outline icons in Ink Black or Cyan Signal.

layout.hero: Left-aligned text, one cyan-highlighted phrase, dual pill CTAs, trust row, and floating dashboard preview.
layout.sections: 96px vertical gaps with calm editorial pacing.
layout.nav: Logo left, centered nav links, avatar cluster, sign-in, and cyan CTA right.

preview.note: Refero exposes preview imagery, but local download was not captured in this environment.
